title: THE CLIMB II · NEW RUNGS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · same ladder style, 5 new loaded stations, 8 / 12 / 16, legs 7.5 → 8.5
why: Same style as yesterday by request: 3 laps of 5 loaded stations, reps 8 / 12 / 16, every station onto a 0.15 mi leg that gets faster each lap. Every station is new: double swing, front-rack lunge, push-up on the bells, gorilla row, weighted bridge.

blocks.title: THE CLIMB II · 30 MIN · ASCENDING LADDER
blocks.meta: 3 LAPS · 5 STATIONS · 15 RUN LEGS · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · cap 30:00
blocks.format: LADDER · lap 1 = 8 reps per station · lap 2 = 12 · lap 3 = 16 (unilateral: per side is half) · every station exits onto a 0.15 mi leg · one clock · count laps, then time
blocks.workRest: Legs are 0.15 mi flat. LAP 1 legs @ 7.5. LAP 2 legs @ 8.0. LAP 3 legs @ 8.5. Set the lap speed once, leave it.

S3 · Push-up on the bells ×8 / 12 / 16 → RUN LEG

items.name: S5 · Weighted glute bridge 50 lb ×8 / 12 / 16 → RUN LEG

blocks.noteGreen: Log finish time, RPE, and whether 8.5 held for all five lap-3 legs.
blocks.text: ★ DOUBLE SWING — hike, snap, bells to chest height, stand tall at the top. ★ FRONT-RACK LUNGE — bells racked, elbows in, back knee kisses the floor. ★ GORILLA ROW — flat back the whole set, no rotation. ★ RUN LEG — step on moving, quick feet, find the stride by the end of the leg.
